name: Haus Pettneu
beschreibung: The Haus Pettneu welcomes guests to the charming village centre of Pettneu am Arlberg, nestled right at the base of the prominent Hoher Riffler summit. The lovingly designed Tyrolean-style guest rooms include satellite TV, Wi-Fi, modern bathrooms, and sunny balconies with panoramic views across the Stanzer Valley and the Arlberg mountains. After an active day outdoors, guests can unwind in the on-site sauna or relax in the cosy lounge by the traditional tiled stove. The complimentary ski bus stops right nearby, whisking winter enthusiasts to St. Anton am Arlberg and Austria's largest interconnected ski expanse, Ski Arlberg, within minutes. In summer, varied hiking and climbing circuits across the Verwall and Lechtal ranges start close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine guesthouse in the centre of Pettneu am Arlberg featuring cosy rooms, sauna, and swift access to Ski Arlberg.
